name: Matjaž Nemec - § 29 - Am 23
title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2026
part_text: 29. Rejects the planned EUR 11,45 million investment in 2026 for the Europa Experiences spaces, considering it an unacceptable waste of public funds at the expense of the real priorities of European citizens; stresses that maintaining high costs for these largely underutilised infrastructures constitutes an inefficient and irresponsible management of budgetary resources; denounces the limited interest in these centres, whose attendance remains marginal, and criticises their use as a propaganda tool to promote an increasingly centralised Union at the expense of Member States' sovereignty; rejects any attempt to expand that costly initiative and calls for the abandonment of further investments in those spaces;
